visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video frame is split into three horizontal sections. The top and bottom sections feature a static, high-quality illustration of a male anime character with a white top hat and monocle against a dark city skyline. The middle section displays a mobile MOBA game interface with character icons and Chinese text overlays. (2) The middle game screen shows a 3D arena environment where a character in a white cloak (a special skin for the game hero) moves across green terrain. The character is controlled by the player, navigating around forest obstacles and map structures with smooth, fluid motions. (3) The character engages in combat, initiating several magical skill effects that manifest as glowing blue circles and white light trails. Floating numbers and status text in Chinese appear above the characters to indicate combat damage and health changes. (4) The sequence concludes with rapid combat highlights where the main character dashes between enemies, executing them with flashy blue and white visual effects. The UI health bars and skill icons flash as they are activated, while the background anime art remains static throughout.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Energetic electronic pop music with a bright synthesizer melody and a heavy 4/4 drum beat begins. The track is studio-clean with no audible ambient floor. (2) A male Japanese voice with a theatrical, high-arousal tone enters, speaking with clear articulation and confident delivery. The catchphrase 'Ladies and Gentlemen' is heard. (3) A series of 'whoosh' and 'shimmer' sound effects are introduced as the character in the video uses skills. These SFX have high spectral brightness and short duration. (4) More intense 'thud' and 'impact' sounds are layered into the mix as combat reaches its climax. The music stays at a consistent high energy before both music and SFX are cut off cleanly at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is designed to showcase the 'Kaito Kid' collaboration skin in a mobile MOBA game. It uses high-energy music and professional Japanese voice acting to create a sense of excitement and skill, aiming to appeal to game enthusiasts and fans of the Detective Conan anime series.
